The '''Theed Landing Plaza''' was a large [[plaza]] where diplomatic [[Starship/Legends|ships]] could land. Before the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and his escort arrived there in a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]].
